reason: A offers the more physically defensible and controlled hypothesis: diffusion-enabled chemical partitioning during slow cooling or aging can destabilize a quenched metastable BCC solid solution and is directly testable against a rapid-quench baseline. B adds an insufficiently supported claim that segregation-generated elastic strain is the trigger and invokes an inherent “sluggish diffusion effect”; its cited studies support decomposition in related alloys but do not establish that strain-driven mechanism.
